coverage_note: Medi's Latin-letter stretches: 03:07 'amalit tilha' (her chat 3meltelha), 05:39 'fin tain el tod' (= tentain illa tult, his own fix of 05:34 تلات إلا تلت, not scored), 30:11 'mara-mara-maratat' (= his try at mattarat), 40:40 'Aja ktir', 44:03 'behre' (= bi7re2), 44:20 'nar heret me', 46:03 'nadafti nadafet'. Amal lines the engine got wrong: 16:49 فئة واحدة؟ = bas wa7de? (prompting the plural); 20:12/20:30 'يوم' = غيم and شوفي = شو في; 32:14 زعلتكش عن = 8eir 3an; 38:47 ريم = غيم; 43:06/43:17 بهدئ = بيحرق; 47:24 وحدات؟ = wa7de? (prompting the plural); 13:41 دلبلي = دير بالي. 1:03:04 the engine wrote مش فيهن، ما فيهن; Amal's reply (مش في... مش هون) shows he said mish fi hoan. Left out on purpose: 30:29 ثلاث مرة → مرات (he fixed it himself before Amal spoke); 36:45 تلجات → her تَلَّجَت (a vowel/shadda slip, pronunciation, S4/F2); 18:47 سجر/فجر (one root letter off, could be S4, filed as a didn't-know because he said أنا نسيت الكلمة); 29:41 'is the verb بمطر؟' (a question, not a slip); 44:20 النار حرقتني (he repeated her model from 44:14); 50:27 حجار (his own fix); 1:06:49 عافيا فيكي (her يعطيك العافية reads as her own reply, not a recast); 23:51 واحدة شمس (Amal said great job). Medi turn count is approximate.

rows.why: He is talking about his fiancée (female) and used the masculine adjective; Amal recast it as feminine عيانة.
Right after her 02:00 fix he said the masculine عيان again and she fixed it again to عيانة, so it counts as its own slip (GR-32).
rows.english: My fiancée is a bit sick

rows.why: He put the verb right after هي and added راسها afterwards; Amal recast the order as هي راسها بيوجع. His 04:07 line is a repeat of her fix.

rows.medi_said: I don't know how to say cough. She has a cough.
rows.amal_said: They say but كح. I say كحة.
rows.why: He asked how to say cough and Amal supplied كحة (a didn't-know).

rows.medi_said: لـ النار for fire, for the fi-- No, for... I don't know how we would...
rows.why: After قلقانين he used لـ; Amal prompted 'worried from' and gave من, and he said من نار.

rows.amal_said: no. There's another word for that.
rows.right: (another verb for a fire starting, not given)
rows.why: He used يبدأ (begin) for a fire starting; Amal said no, there is another word, and put it aside.

rows.medi_said: do I know how to say taking care or like caring for? I don't know how to say this right.
rows.why: He asked how to say 'take care of' and Amal supplied دير بالي (on her sheet as 'Ana badir baali 3ala').
He left out على (and the -i ending) after دير بال; Amal recast it with على. It came while she was guiding him through the phrase, so confidence is medium.
rows.english: I took care of my fiancée

rows.why: He dropped على again after her 09:51 fix; Amal named the rule ('بدير بالي takes على').
rows.english: I took care of my fiancée

rows.amal_said: دير بالك is actually the command form.
rows.why: باليك is not a valid possessive ending (it should be بالك); Amal gave دير بالك and noted that it is the command form.
After خلينا the next verb is a bare present verb; he used the past عملنا and Amal recast it as نعمل.

rows.medi_said: خلينا نعمل الدرس إنه، uh, إنه تخطط-- uh, تخططي.
rows.why: He meant 'the lesson that you planned' but used إنه for illi and a present verb for the past; Amal only asked كيف يعني? and moved on without fixing it.

rows.medi_said: Oh, is it, is it، is it عصافير؟
rows.why: He offered عصافير (birds) for sky; Amal said no and later supplied سما after he said he forgot.
Amal asked 'just one?' and he switched to the plural غيوم, which she accepted.

rows.medi_said: When, when do you look at the sky? When do you watch the sky?
rows.amal_said: No، امتى بتتطلع على الشمس would be when do you watch the sky؟ امتى الشمس بتطلع؟
rows.why: He understood her بتطلع as بتتطلع (look) and she corrected his reading.

rows.medi_said: أنا نسيت الكلمة بس سجر. سجر؟
rows.amal_said: فجر. You could have just said الصبح بكير
rows.why: He said he forgot the word and guessed سجر; Amal supplied فجر (the word is on her sheet as el-fajer).
He added لو to غير for 'other than'; Amal said 'No لو. غير.'

rows.medi_said: غير الشمس و غيوم شو، شو في.
rows.amal_said: بس غير شمس و يوم (= غيم).
rows.why: Amal recast it without el- after غير and repeated غير شمس at 20:30 when he asked 'isn't it the sun?'
rows.english: Other than the sun and clouds, what is there?

rows.chat: el-sma billail fi el-2amar u njoom
rows.why: Amal recast his 'night sky' as السما بالليل (el- on سما, noun first) and he repeated it.
Amal echoed تاني as a prompt, he changed it to the feminine تانية to match نجمة, and she accepted it (her chat has taanie).
Amal named the pointer rule and he added -ha: بشوفها ('I forgot the pointer rule').
rows.english: This is the first star I see today

rows.medi_said: since is لسـ-- لسا, right? ... Is it لا؟
rows.amal_said: No. Since-- لا is until. ... من.
rows.why: He offered لسا and then لا for 'since'; Amal said no and supplied من.

rows.chat: min awal el-yoam, mattarat talat marraat
rows.why: He could not form the feminine past of 'rain'; Amal supplied مطرت and he repeated it.
He said الأول (the first) for الهوا; Amal recast it, and when he asked 'what did I say?' she answered الأول.

rows.medi_said: آآ، غير من because it's comparative, right?
rows.why: 'Different from' is 8eir 3an; Amal gave عن and he said 'غير always takes عن'.

rows.amal_said: آخر المرة means the last of the time. The end of the time. ... آخر مرة. The last time.
rows.chat: aa5er marra tallajat kaanat 2abel talat sneen
rows.why: آخر + el- means 'the end of'; Amal explained it and gave آخر مرة for 'the last time'.
The subject مرة is feminine; Amal prompted 'مرة is' and he fixed it to كانت.

rows.amal_said: No. ... Ago is قبل. So قبل ثلاث سنين.
rows.why: Amal said no and gave the 'ago' rule: قبل + number + noun.
He said سنان (teeth) for سنين (years); Amal asked what it meant and gave سنين.

rows.amal_said: إيش يعني عجل؟ ... عجا كتير الصباح؟ إيش يعني؟
rows.right: الهوا إجا (his fix); Amal steered him to الهوا كان قوي
rows.why: He used the plural verb أجو with the masculine singular الهوا; after Amal asked what he meant he said 'it's singular. Aja ktir.'
rows.english: The wind came a lot in the morning

rows.why: He left the object 'it' off the verb; Amal prompted 'It.' and he said nadafetha.
Amal asked 'one?' about his singular الوردة and he changed it to the plural وردات.

rows.medi_said: Is it the bee? Is it the bee plants? (engine wrote bee)
rows.amal_said: زبيب؟ ... Z-z-zبيب is raisins, I think. ... زريعة.
rows.why: Amal's echo زبيب shows he said zbeeb (raisins) for plants; she supplied زريعة.

rows.medi_said: I don't, أنا بعرف، ما بعرف.
rows.why: Amal asked for 'stones', he said he didn't know, and she supplied حجر.

rows.amal_said: صخر is under the sea, under the ocean.
rows.why: Amal asked for 'rocks', he said ما بعرف, and she then mentioned صخر.
He meant streets (plural); Amal recast it as الشوارع and he repeated it.
He gave the plural adjective without el- after الشوارع; Amal added el- (الإدام) and he took it.

rows.amal_said: Or just حجر. Are stone. ... Made of is different than made. ... الشوارع الإدام في أمريكا حجر.
rows.why: He built 'made with stone' using عملت مع; Amal said 'made of is different' and recast it as a plain noun sentence with no verb and no مع.
rows.english: The old streets in America are (made of) stone

rows.amal_said: تاني حجر or الحجر التاني. You said it first right.
rows.why: Noun + تاني means 'another', not 'the second'; Amal gave تاني حجر / الحجر التاني.

rows.amal_said: So you could either say my favorite stone or my favorite using عندي. المفضل عندي.
rows.why: He put a possessive ending on مفضل; Amal gave المفضل عندي (el- + 3ind when it stands alone).

rows.medi_said: مفضل-- مفضل عندي أو مفضل لي يعني؟
rows.why: He dropped el- from المفضل; Amal prompted 'الـ' and repeated المفضل عندي.

rows.medi_said: I was gonna say الـ مفضل حجر.
rows.amal_said: الحجر المفضل or حجري المفضل. المفضل is an adjective.
rows.why: He put مفضل before the noun; Amal said it is an adjective, so it goes after: الحجر المفضل.

rows.medi_said: Yeah، okay. So الـ حجري الـ مفضل.
rows.why: A noun with a possessive ending never takes el-; Amal said 'No ال first'.

rows.amal_said: But al-mufaddal is an adjective, so it follows ders. ... هاد الدرس المفضل عندي.
rows.why: For 'this lesson is my favorite' he left el- off مفضل again; Amal explained it is an adjective following الدرس and gave الدرس المفضل عندي.

rows.medi_said: مش فيهن، ما فيهن. (engine; = mish fi hoan)
rows.amal_said: مش هون. مش، مش في. مش هون. ... في is not is. في is there is.
rows.why: He used في as 'is' ('isn't here'); Amal said في means 'there is' and gave مش هون.

rows.medi_said: ديرت بالي على خطيبتي كل الصباح.
rows.why: He uses the MSA form الصباح (again at 40:30 and 41:01) where her sheet and chat have el-subu7; she never voiced a fix.
